project: Kenya at Gold: The Governance Ledger
framework: Sports Governance Observer (SGO) / National Sports Governance Observer (NSGO)
developed_by: Arnout Geeraert (KU Leuven) for Play the Game / Danish Institute for Sports Studies
methodology_note: Original NSGO tool: 274 indicators grouped into 46 principles across 4 dimensions, applied via dichotomous (yes/no) scoring to national sports federations in 15+ countries (round 2: Bosnia, Bulgaria, Canada, Colombia, Georgia, Iceland, India, Indonesia, Lithuania, Portugal, Serbia, Slovenia, Spain, Ukraine, USA). This project adapts the 4-dimension structure to score Athletics Kenya and ADAK using publicly documented evidence, following the same dichotomous logic. This is an independent adaptation, not an official Play the Game assessment.

dimensions.name: Transparency
dimensions.definition: An organisation's reporting on its internal workings, allowing others to scrutinise decisions and finances.
example_indicators_applied: Are ADAK/Athletics Kenya annual reports publicly available?
Are testing statistics (counts, sports, outcomes) published on a regular schedule?
Is funding source and amount (e.g. WADA agreements, government allocations) publicly disclosed?

dimensions.name: Democratic processes
dimensions.definition: Free, fair, competitive elections; involvement of affected actors (athletes) in decision-making; open internal debate.
example_indicators_applied: Is there documented athlete representation in Athletics Kenya governance structures?
Are leadership elections documented and contested?

dimensions.name: Internal accountability and control
dimensions.definition: Separation of powers within governance structure; rules and procedures ensuring compliance with internal norms.
example_indicators_applied: Is there a documented, independent disciplinary/tribunal process for doping cases (distinct from AIU's own process)?
Are corrective action plans (e.g. ADAK's 2024-25 WADA-mandated plan) publicly tracked to completion?

dimensions.name: Societal responsibility
dimensions.definition: Accountability to broader stakeholders: athlete welfare, anti-discrimination, community impact.
example_indicators_applied: Are athlete welfare programs (financial, medical, post-career) documented and funded?
Is there a public education/awareness program for clean sport (e.g. ADAK's education campaigns)?

status: Framework adopted 2026; full indicator-by-indicator scoring against Athletics Kenya/ADAK is the next data-collection task (see docs/methodology.md) — no scores fabricated, only the source-backed structure is committed at this stage.
